title: Software Engineer | Post Trade Analytics
description:
Jump Trading Group is committed to world-class research. We empower exceptional talent in Mathematics, Physics, and Computer Science to seek scientific boundaries, push through them, and apply cutting-edge research to global financial markets. Our culture is unique. Constant innovation requires fearlessness, creativity, intellectual honesty, and a relentless competitive streak. We believe in winning together and unlocking unique individual talent by fostering collaboration and mutual respect. At Jump, research outcomes drive more than superior risk-adjusted returns. We design, develop, and deploy technologies that change our world, fund start-ups across industries, and partner with leading global research organizations and universities to solve complex problems.  Jump Trading's Post-Trade Analytics (PTA) Team is the firm's central source of truth for understanding how we trade. We measure, analyze, and optimize every dimension of our trading activity across all global markets. Our team builds the foundational analyses that traders and quantitative researchers rely on daily to make critical decisions. Operating across highly diverse datasets, our core infrastructure collects, organizes, and stores billions of data points every day, powering the analytics behind a wide array of trading strategies.  As a Software Engineer on the PTA team, you will own the critical datasets and pipelines upon which our trading decisions are built, all while developing in-depth technical and financial business expertise. 
  What You'll Do:  
 
 Partner directly with traders and quantitative researchers to turn complex questions into data products that shape how we trade across global markets. 
 Build, operate, and scale the robust datasets and pipelines that power our post-trade analytics and research. 
 Directly influence business priorities, trading strategies, and execution quality through high-impact data engineering. 
 Guarantee trust in the numbers by building robust data validation frameworks, monitoring, alerting, data lineage, and executing rapid incident response. 
 Drive performance by optimizing data processing and workflows for speed, cost, and resilience, while diagnosing and resolving the most complex pipeline and production issues. 
 Develop and optimize the tools, documentation, and foundational infrastructure that empower the broader research and trading teams. 
 Other duties as needed 
 
  Skills You’ll Need:  
 
 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or Software Engineer working extensively with large-scale data. 
 Proficiency in Python or C++ (Strong skills in at least one, with a willingness to work across both). 
 Proven expertise in building, operating, and scaling ETL/ELT pipelines, including orchestration, scheduling, and dependency management. 
 Strong command of SQL and the broader data analytics ecosystem, including familiarity with libraries such as Pandas and NumPy. 
 Sharp analytical and problem-solving abilities, paired with a strong curiosity to understand the financial business logic behind the data. 
 Comfort and proficiency working within Linux environments. 
 Reliable and predictable availability

职位介绍
 一、岗位职责

title: 集团财务经理
company: 天津永文汽车部件有限公司
description:
职位介绍
 岗位职责：
一、财务战略与管控体系
统筹国内与海外财务战略规划，构建多区域、多币种、多准则的集团化财务管理体系，确保各地法定报表与集团合并报表双重合规；主导总部财务制度落地与属地适配，参与公司重大经营决策并提供财务战略建议。
二、全面预算与经营分析
组织编制国内与海外整体年度预算及中长期预测，建立预算执行差异分析闭环；编制审核合并管理报表，跟踪损益、现金流、营运资本周转率、项目毛利率等关键指标，为管理层提供决策依据。
三、核算质量与成本管控
监督各主体会计核算质量，确保财务报告准确及时；建立优化成本核算与分析体系，推动标准成本管理与降本增效，提升整体毛利率与成本竞争力。
四、资金与外汇管理
审批国内与海外月度资金计划与重大支付，统筹全球现金流管理；主导多币种汇率风险管理与对冲策略执行；维护国内外金融机构关系，拓展融资渠道，降低资金成本。
五、税务合规与筹划
负责各主体税务合规与按时申报；研究各地税收法规，识别跨境税务风险，制定合法税务筹划方案；对接各地税务机关及代理，主导税务稽查与审计应对。
六、业务支持与投资评估
参与国内外投资项目财务评估与风险测算，支持业务拓展；融入业务前端，对定价、商务政策提出建议；对接总部、各区域管理层及职能部门，推动跨组织协同。
七、团队建设与系统管理
制定国内与海外财务团队工作计划与人才梯队规划，负责人员招聘、培训与绩效管理，培养本土化骨干；推动ERP系统多区域有效运行与持续优化，提升财务数字化水平。
八、内控与风险管理
建立健全国内外财务内控体系，识别关键风险并制定应对措施；主导内审配合与整改闭环；建立财务风险预警机制，定期向管理层汇报重大风险事项。
 岗位任职要求：
1. 本科及以上，财会、财管相关专业；10 年以上财务工作经验，5 年以上制造行业集团财务负责人 / 财务总监经验；有汽车零部件、注塑、精密制造行业优先。
2. 证书：CPA 优先；CMA、ACCA 加分；熟悉国内会计准则、税法；有海外多国家子公司管理经验，懂跨境税务、转让定价、多国准则差异。
3. 系统能力：精通 SAP 等集团 ERP，熟练合并报表、成本核算、预算体系；有集团财务数字化升级经验。
4. 语言：英语商务流利，可独立对接海外工厂、海外会计师事务所、境外银行；西语不强制加分。
5. 具备投资测算、融资方案设计、税务筹划、跨区域财务管控能力；有处理海外税务稽查、跨境资金难题实战经验。"

title: 叶片健康监测工程师
company: 上海合璟安新能源科技有限公司
description:
职位介绍
 岗位职责：
1. 技术方案设计与选型
 - 根据产品定义（要监测的失效模式、性能指标、目标成本、增量 / 存量场景），寻找或搭建最合适的传感方案：应变、振动、声学、光纤光栅、视觉等路线及组合的评估与取舍。
 - 具备找供应商的能力：持续扫描市面方案与供应商，主导技术交流、方案评估与选型，识别指标虚标、工况不适配、成本隐藏项等坑。
 - 灵活思维：能根据真实场景调整技术路线，不被单一方案绑架，能评估并推动内外部合作落地。
2. 技术指标制定
 - 根据产品定义，制定传感链路各环节的具体技术指标：传感器性能、布置方案、采集、供电供网、通讯、数据质量、可靠性等。
 - 输出产品需求、验收标准，作为开发、测试和供应商交付物的评判依据。
3. 新产品开发主导与资源拉通
 - 选型确定后，拉通团队内部（硬件、软件、算法、结构、工艺）与外部（供应商 / ODM / JDM）各环节资源，主导技术开发，把方案从纸面推进到样机。
 - 主导新产品开发（EVT / DVT）阶段的开发、验证与准出，组织测试执行与问题闭环。
 - 与项目经理一起推动技术研发、测试、试制、生产，对数据采集侧技术把关。
4. 小批量导入与迭代
 - 推动存量风机 小批量导入及追踪、增量风机小批量导入。
 - 小批量准出验证，支持量产阶段导入及运维工作支持。
 - 收集现场运行数据与问题，为产品线迭代提供输入，形成"试点 → 反馈 → 选型迭代"闭环。

任职要求：
- 本科及以上学历，传感、测控、自动化、电子工程、工程力学、复合材料等相关专业。
- 8 年以上工业监测 / 传感 / 测试 / 诊断相关经验，其中至少 3 年以上与风电叶片、结构健康监测、旋转机械或大型装备状态监测相关。
- 有完整产品开发经验：完整跟过至少一个从"技术选型 → 样机 → 验证 → 试点导入"的项目，能讲清楚当时怎么选型、踩过什么坑。
- 有找供应商和供应商技术对接的经验，敢质疑、会提要求，不被供应商 PPT 带走。
- 技术广度够：对传感原理（应变 / 振动 / 声学 / 光学 / 边缘计算等）至少两类以上有实操级理解，不是只听过名词。
- 沟通能力强，能拉通团队内外各环节资源，主导跨团队技术开发。
- Base 上海，能接受约 20%-30% 出差（主要国内风场样机测试 / 挂样，少量国际项目）。

面向各行业成长型企业、中型企业、高价值中小企业及有明确AI应用需求的大型企业业务单元，负责复杂需求诊断、多角色决策沟通、跨部门方案设计、试用或POC推进、商务推进、上线协同与复盘。该岗位不限定行业、地区或单一业务场景，服务对象为广泛企业客户。
本岗位更偏复杂需求、多个决策角色、跨部门方案、试用/POC和较长销售周期；强调解决方案销售能力，而不是替代技术售前或交付团队。候选人不需要来自某一个固定行业，但需要具备快速理解客户业务与组织决策的能力。
行业示例包括但不限于：商贸与批发零售、消费品、电商与内容服务、制造与工业品、物流与供应链、建筑工程与物业、教育培训、文旅与酒店、专业服务、财税法务、人力资源、咨询、企业服务、软件与信息技术、互联网、金融科技相关企业服务、医疗健康相关非临床经营场景、能源环保、农业及其他有数字化与效率提升需求的企业。上述列举仅为示例，不构成行业限制；
【岗位职责】：
1.负责各行业成长型、中型企业、高价值中小企业及大型企业业务单元的复杂商机跟进，识别客户组织结构、决策链路、预算来源、采购路径和关键推进风险。

3.梳理跨部门流程、角色权限、知识与数据来源、文件与数据处理方式、现有软件系统、交付边界、上线条件和预期业务效果，明确适合AI员工落地的优先场景。
4.围绕多场景协同、企业知识库、工作流、文件与数据处理、客户服务、销售运营、内部协作及现有系统协同等方向，形成可演示、可试用、可评估的解决方案。
5.组织并推进需求访谈、场景筛选、方案演示、试用或POC、试用目标设定、效果评估和价值复盘，协调产品、交付、技术、运营等内部资源。
6.推动商务方案、报价、采购、法务、信息安全评估、合同、回款、上线及复盘等关键环节，提升复杂项目推进效率。
7.将项目中的共性需求、行业差异、客户异议、方案模板和成功案例沉淀为可复用销售资产。
8.关注项目上线后的实际使用效果和客户长期价值，避免用未经验证的功能承诺、合规判断或经营结果承诺推动成交。
【任职要求】：
1.统招本科及以上学历。
2.具备3年以上To B解决方案销售、企业软件/SaaS销售、数字化转型、咨询式销售、系统集成、企业服务项目销售或复杂客户销售经验；任何行业只要有可验证的To B开发和成交业绩均可，不因行业背景排除。
3.能够理解客户组织结构、多角色决策、跨部门流程和采购路径，具备复杂项目推进、资源协调和关键风险识别能力。
4.具备行业迁移能力，能够快速理解新行业的客户角色、业务链条、经营指标、流程和常用术语，并把共性需求与行业特性区分开。
5.具备较强的需求访谈、方案表达和演示能力，能够把AI员工能力转化为客户看得懂的业务场景、流程变化、实施边界和评估方式。
6.理解试用或POC的基本管理方法，能够跟进目标、范围、数据与知识来源、责任人、时间表、验收标准和复盘结论。
7.坚持职业诚信，严格保护客户数据、客户资料和商业秘密；不要求携带原公司客户名单或数据，也不以声称拥有大量私人关系作为录用依据。
8.对外沟通稳健，不夸大AI能力，不承诺未经验证的功能、合规结论、上线周期或经营效果。

【优先考虑】：
•来自SaaS、企业软件、企业服务、咨询、数字化、CRM、ERP、协同办公、客服、知识库、自动化、数据工具等背景。
•有ERP、CRM、OA、MES、PLM、BI、RPA、低代码、智能客服、知识库、协同办公、云服务、数据分析或流程自动化等企业级产品销售经验。
•有商贸与批发零售、消费品、电商与内容服务、制造与工业品、物流与供应链、建筑工程与物业、教育培训、文旅与酒店、专业服务、财税法务、人力资源、咨询、企业服务、软件与信息技术、互联网、金融科技相关企业服务、医疗健康相关非临床经营场景、能源环保、农业等任一行业解决方案经验。
•有POC、试点项目、客户成功、交付协同、信息安全评估或采购流程推进经验，能推动客户从试用走向正式上线。
•能够沉淀行业案例、方案模板、演示脚本、客户价值复盘材料或复杂项目推进方法。

title: Account Development Representative

You will develop technical fluency across modern application architectures, cloud infrastructure, and database technologies, gaining real exposure to how complex software solutions are positioned and sold.  ADRs at MongoDB do more than generate meetings. They help shape early deal strategy, apply MEDDIC principles to qualify real business problems, and stay engaged through the scoping phase to maintain strong deal momentum  
 We invest heavily in structured onboarding, ongoing enablement, and consistent 1:1 coaching. Our ADR team is one of the primary talent pipelines into Account Executive and other revenue roles across MongoDB, with clear, performance-based progression paths. 
 Hybrid Model 
 We believe skill development accelerates when teams collaborate in person. This is a hybrid role based in Shanghai, China. 
 What you’ll do 
 
 Own outbound prospecting within a defined set of strategic accounts, working closely with your aligned Account Executives and Sales stakeholders.

 Consistently exceed monthly and quarterly opportunity targets.

 Has a track record of setting goals and exceeding them in competitive or performance-driven environments. 
 Communicates clearly and confidently in Mandarin and English (fluent). 
 Takes ownership of outcomes and follows through on commitments. 
 Can manage a high level of outbound activity while maintaining quality and attention to detail. 
 Is coachable and actively applies feedback. 
 Learns technical concepts quickly and is curious about how businesses use technology. 
 Is serious about building a long-term career in technology sales. 
 Is comfortable initiating conversations with senior stakeholders and handling rejection professionally. 
 
 Things We Love 
 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Marketing, Communications, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

description:
As a Customer Success Manager, you are the trusted advisor helping a high volume of customers navigate their journey on MongoDB using proactive, scalable engagement strategies initiated by health signals and journey milestones. You’ll be responsible for maximizing customer lifetime value and success for a diverse portfolio of thousands of expanding MongoDB customers, acting as a strategic connector between your customers and providing the right help at the right time to achieve their unique business goals. You’ll drive healthy adoption, customer retention, revenue realization, and advocacy at scale. You will innovate, navigate ambiguity, and build scalable programs and processes to deliver real, measurable impact where your customers need it most. 
 We are looking for Mandarin speaking candidates who are based in Hong Kong for our hybrid working model. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Customer Advisory 
 
 Lead and scale effective customer onboarding by leveraging product adoption telemetry to monitor early deployment health, proactively identify and mitigate configuration risks, and guide customers through prescriptive best practices, architectures, and operational strategies that establish a strong technical foundation and accelerate time-to-value and achieve customers’ business outcomes with MongoDB 
 Drive ongoing consumption and value realization through a mix of 1:1 and 1:many engagements (e.g., targeted campaigns, webinars, office hours), using data-driven insights to identify trends, opportunities, and risks across a broad customer portfolio and recommending optimal solutions, features, and adoption paths to achieve customers’ business outcomes with MongoDB 
 
 Account & Portfolio Management 
 
 Own elements of the account plan that drive customer maturity and lifetime value, retention, and revenue realization. Proactively manage thousands of customers across various stages of maturity by leveraging 1-to-many methodologies and tools to balance individual customer impact with scalable outcomes that maximize long-term success 
 Track and report progress against key business outcomes, forecast revenue retention and realization to senior leadership for business predictability, and identify new opportunities to expand customer impact, collaborating with presales teams to support growth 
 Maintain meticulous hygiene in internal systems to ensure a single source of truth for customer insights and accurate territory analysis. Leverage AI-driven tools to streamline daily workflows, improve productivity, and optimize customer success outcomes 
 
 Internal Collaboration & Customer Advocacy 
 
 Amplify the voice of the customer within MongoDB, leveraging customer insights to inform MongoDB’s product roadmap and coordinate across Sales, Product, Services, Support, and Training teams to drive customer health, satisfaction, and value realization 
 Connect customers with the right internal resources, while contributing learnings from customer interactions to strengthen team success and maximize customer value. Contribute to the evolution of scalable programs that enhance efficiency, customer satisfaction, and measurable outcomes 
 
 What You Will Bring 
 
 Relevant Experience: 5 to 7+ years in a technical customer-facing role (e.g., Technical Customer Success, Solutions Architecture/Engineering, Professional Services/Implementation, Technical Account Management) for a deeply technical, ideally consumption-based, product

Experience in managing scaled or pooled portfolios utilizing scalable strategies to enhance customer retention is a plus. Familiarity with designing workflows or engagement strategies using AI or automation-driven tools 
 Communication: Excellent verbal and written skills with the ability to influence technical and business outcomes

They listen thoughtfully to understand the context of a business problem and write clean and iterative code to deliver a powerful end result whilst consistently advocating for better engineering practices. By balancing strong opinions with a willingness to find the right answer, Senior Software Developers bring integrity to technology, ensuring all voices are heard.

title: Staff / Sr. Staff Engineer, AI Gateway
description:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope 
 Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs. 
 At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security. 
 Visit  Careers at Netskope  to learn more. Follow us on  LinkedIn  and  Instagram .    Please note, this team is hiring across all levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience.  
  About the Role  
 Netskope AI Gateway helps global enterprises securely adopt, scale, and govern Generative AI. We are seeking a  Staff / Sr. Staff Software Engineer  to architect, build, and scale the core systems powering our AI Gateway product and its supporting microservices across SaaS and on-prem/hybrid environments. 
 Based in Taiwan, you will be a technical anchor for our core development team. This is a hands-on, high-impact individual contributor role focused on building highly scalable backend systems, with real ownership: the systems assigned to you are yours to design, build, and defend — depth matters more than volume. You will operate at the intersection of deep distributed systems engineering and cutting-edge AI technology. We are looking for an engineering leader who leverages AI to accelerate their workflows, but possesses the rigorous, production-grade coding skills required to architect complex systems, ensure enterprise-grade security, and validate AI-generated code. 
  What You Will Be Doing  
 
  Core Backend Development:  Architect, build, and scale our core AI Gateway solutions, backend services, and high-throughput APIs. You will focus on writing highly concurrent, robust, and maintainable software, primarily in  Golang . 
  Command AI-Driven Engineering:  Integrate AI and agent-based tooling (e.g., Copilots, code generators) into your daily development workflow to accelerate scaffolding, boilerplate, and hypothesis generation.  Crucially, you will act as the gatekeeper:  you must possess the deep software engineering expertise to audit AI-generated code, ensure architectural soundness, and reject code that introduces technical debt or security flaws. 
  Design for Scale and Resilience:  Build distributed systems capable of handling immense data payloads, streaming LLM responses (Server-Sent Events), and complex proxy routing without introducing unacceptable latency. 
  Cross-Functional Collaboration:  Partner directly with global engineering, AI researchers, and product teams. Translate ambitious AI features into scalable, maintainable software architectures. Raise system design considerations before a single line of feature code is written. 
  Push Engineering Excellence:  Drive the technical culture of the Taiwan team through architectural reviews, code reviews, and mentorship. Advocate for best practices in modern, AI-augmented software development, security, and scalable system design. 
  Deep Systems Debugging:  While not primarily an incident support role, you will be the ultimate escalation point for the hardest systemic development roadblocks. Trace complex issues across asynchronous microservice

4、授课感染力：口齿伶俐，台风稳健，有线上直播或企业内训经验者优先。

请发送您的简历/从业背景，注明“讲师应聘”。

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and even though we've made a lot of headway, we still have work to do — and that’s where you come in! 
 Duolingo’s designers care about creating high-quality  experiences that look and feel fun . From animators to writers, product designers to researchers, Design brings purpose, feeling, and delight to every interaction with our brand, inside the app and out. As a designer, you’ll join a culture of creativity and craft, where we have a high bar for excellence and an endless curiosity about how to bring more unexpected quirk and fun to the pursuit of learning.  
 Join us in our mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world. 
 
  About the role...  
 This role is an important part of the Design team, partnering with other designers and cross-functional teammates on features across our mobile apps, website, and communications. From polishing learner flows to supporting campaigns and community moments, you’ll help shape friendly, intuitive experiences that feel distinctly Duolingo. We care deeply about craft, so you’ll grow your skills while contributing to work that’s both user-friendly and fun, sweating the details to get them just right.  
   
  🧠  You will...  
 
 Design and prototype simple, playful learning experiences for the Duolingo app 
 Drive large work streams across your team with independence—you’ll lead! 
 Be a peer leader and mentor across Duolingo Design 
 Work with other designers and artists to expand Duolingo’s design language 
 Partner with engineers and product managers to define what we build, and how we get there 
 Consider every part of a finely crafted experience: animation, copy, UI to business impact 
 
   
  ✅  You have...  
 
 An online portfolio featuring simple consumer mobile apps 
 The highest bar for visual design and interaction details 
 Fluency in creating high fidelity prototypes quickly 
 Experience shipping products at scale in a product organization 
 The ability to explain your work and decisions simply and concisely 
 A big appetite for feedback to help you make your best work 
 A bravery in solving hard problems within ambiguity and complexity 
 
   
  ⭐  Exceptional candidates will have...  
 
 The desire to make decisions fast 
 Know-how using AI and LLMs to make interesting ideas from scratch 
 Deep understanding for brand, and a brand’s role in business 
 Skills shaping motion and animation for user interfaces 
 A track record of career growth within previous companies 
 A reputation of being a top performer and is sought after by other leaders

 The role will cover strategic enterprise customers within the Greater China region.  
 Lakebase gives customers a unified, governed foundation for operational workloads and AI-native applications, helping them move away from a fragmented estate of point databases toward a modern, scalable, serverless Postgres service. If you want to be at the forefront of operational databases for AI and intelligent applications at one of the fastest-growing data and AI companies in the world, this is your opportunity. 
  The impact you will have  
 
 Drive new Lakebase revenue by identifying, qualifying, and closing Lakebase opportunities within a defined territory, in partnership with regional Account Executives and the broader account team. 
 Lead with outcomes for key Lakebase personas — including platform teams and developers, data teams, and central IT — articulating how Lakebase helps them ship features faster, simplify operational data architectures, and improve governance and cost efficiency. 
 Sell the value of fully-managed Postgres for intelligent applications, positioning Lakebase as the optimal choice for operational workloads that power real-time, AI-driven experiences. 
 Run complex, multi-threaded sales cycles from discovery and value hypothesis through commercial negotiation and close, navigating executive, technical, and line-of-business stakeholders.

 Enable the field by sharing Lakebase best practices, success stories, and sales motions with broader sales teams, helping scale Lakebase proficiency across the organization. 
 
  What success looks like in this role  
 This role requires the ability to operate across  two key motions  simultaneously: 
 
  Establish top strategic focus accounts  by engaging application development teams to create net-new intelligent applications leveraging Lakebase. 
  Drive longer-term Postgres standardization and migration  within Databricks' most strategic accounts. 
 
 Candidates should demonstrate how they can act as a force multiplier across multiple dimensions of the business. 
 Success in this role requires strength in four areas: 
 
  Business ownership  – Operate at a business-unit level by tracking revenue, pipeline, and key observations, and by identifying areas needing additional focus or support. 
  Strategic account engagement  – Partner with account teams to engage priority accounts across the global DB700, driving strategic opportunities from initial engagement through successful outcomes. 
  Field enablement  – Build and execute enablement plans that empower AEs and SAs to confidently carry the Lakebase conversation even when the specialist is not present.

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.  
  About the team  
 Stripe Terminal helps Stripe users extend their online presence into the physical world. The Terminal team’s mission is to make it as easy for businesses to accept in-person payments as the Stripe API has done for online payments. With Terminal, businesses can unlock in-person payments use cases that are right for their business model—whether it’s creating a flagship retail experience, extending their website to a pop-up store, or enabling a mobile point-of-sale at their next event.  
  What we are looking for:  
 As an Android BSP Engineer, you will be responsible for the kernel and driver level system development, which includes building, troubleshooting, and writing automated tests for the Android system on our embedded payments platforms. This team works closely with partner teams throughout the hardware and software product lifecycle, from hardware manufacturing to Android app teams. We also work with external vendors on part selection and initial hardware bring-up. 
  What you’ll do:  
 
 Bring up new devices and lead debugging and performance tuning exercises that span multiple hardware/firmware/software teams. 
 Design, implement, and maintain drivers and Android services that operate efficiently in a constrained environment and meet the reliability and security requirements of the industry. 
 Own the definition of one or more work streams focused on hardware bring-up, peripheral drivers and communication, and power and performance management and optimization. 
 Analyze bug reports and manage the defect resolution process (disposition issues, resolve issues, and report issue status). 
 Interact with global teams with excellent communication skills to provide support information 
 Routinely perform code reviews to ensure high quality designs and implementation 
 Assist in ensuring quality and timeliness of product/feature development. Work closely with QA staff to ensure appropriate test cases are created, maintained, and executed. 
 Proactively solve problems and work independently and within a team environment, with limited guidance. 
 
  Who you are  
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
  Minimum requirements  
 
 2+ years software engineering experience in device driver development, embedded systems, or operating systems 
 2+ years working with mobile or other connected devices 
 Experience using automated testing, build systems, and inter-component communication protocols such as UART, GPIO, SPI, I2C, etc. 
 Proficiency in C/C++ or Kotlin/Java 
 Experience with Android OS, and familiarity with associated software development tools 
 Degree in CS, CE, EE, or equivalent practical experience 
 Experience adding, monitoring and parsing telemetry data to proactively resolve issues 
 Fluency in both written and spoken English and Mandarin Chinese to be able to communicate with our vendors and users/customers 
 
  Preferred qualifications  
 
 Experience with ARM platform 
 Experience working with microcontrollers 
 Knowledge of EMV. 
 Knowledge of cryptography, symmetric, asymmetric, key management and exchange is an asset. 
 Experience with POS Hardware and peripherals. 
 Knowledge and expertise of PCI technology, transaction processing, and related retail standards.

title: Senior Mechanical and Industrial Design Engineer
description:
Who we are  
  About Stripe  
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
  About the team  
 Stripe Terminal helps businesses extend their online presence into the physical world. Our mission is to make it as easy for businesses to accept in-person payments as the Stripe API has made it for online payments. With Terminal, businesses can create flagship retail experiences, extend their websites to pop-up stores, or enable mobile point-of-sale payments at their next event. All of this is built on the Stripe Payments Platform, so businesses can maintain a single view of customers and sales across online and offline channels. 
 Our hardware engineering team in Taiwan designs and builds the physical payment devices at the heart of that experience, including products such as the Stripe Reader S700 and Stripe Reader M2. We are expanding the team and seeking an experienced Senior Mechanical and Industrial Design Engineer who can own both the structural engineering and aesthetic form language of our next generation of payment terminals. This is a blended role. You will be equally comfortable driving design for manufacturability (DFM) for a plastic enclosure and sketching form concepts that express Stripe's design identity in hardware. 
  What you'll do  
 You will lead the industrial and mechanical design of next-generation Stripe Terminal payment devices, shaping their form, feel, usability, and structural performance from early concepts through mass production. You will partner with cross-functional teams and suppliers to deliver manufacturable, high-quality hardware, including enclosure design, color, material, and finish specifications, packaging, validation, and production readiness. 
  Responsibilities  
  Industrial design  
 
 Lead ideation and concept development through rapid hand sketching, digital sketching, and physical foam or 3D-printed models to explore form factors early in the product lifecycle. 
 Define the visual and tactile design language of Terminal hardware, including proportion, form, surface transitions, button feel, and overall product character. 
 Produce photorealistic product renders using KeyShot or similar tools to communicate design intent to cross-functional teams and executive stakeholders. 
 Define and manage color, material, and finish (CMF) specifications. Work directly with suppliers to qualify target surfaces, textures, and coatings. 
 Manage packaging design, working directly with suppliers to qualify final deliverables and the unboxing experience. 
 Apply ergonomics and human factors principles to ensure products are intuitive and comfortable for a diverse range of users and environments. 
 Maintain visual consistency and brand coherence across the Terminal hardware product family, in alignment with Stripe's design identity. 
 
  Mechanical engineering  
 
 Design mechanical components and assemblies using SolidWorks or Creo, following professional engineering standards. 
 Hands on experience in mechanical designs and drawings, assess manufacturability, and resolve technical problems. 
 Lead and plan problem-solving activities using scientific approaches, such as tolerance analysis, computer-aided engineering (CAE) and finite element method (FEM) simulations, design of experiments (DOE), and physical prototyping. 
 Independently analyze and verify mechanical designs, identify risks, and propose mitigations.

title: Quantitative Developer
description:
About Akuna  
 Akuna Capital is an innovative trading firm with a strong focus on collaboration, cutting-edge technology, data driven solutions and automation. We specialise in providing liquidity as an options market maker – meaning we are committed to providing competitive quotes that we are willing to both buy and sell. To do this successfully we design and implement our own low latency technologies, trading strategies and mathematical models. At Akuna we have a flat structure, where the best idea wins.  Our Founding Partners, including Andrew Killion, first conceptualized Akuna in their hometown of Sydney. They opened the firm’s first office in 2011 in the heart of the derivatives industry and the options capital of the world – Chicago. Today, Akuna is proud to operate from additional offices in Shanghai, Sydney, Singapore and London. 
  What you’ll do as a Quantitative Developer on the Quant Trading & Research team at Akuna:  
 Akuna’s Quantitative Trading and Research team creates trading strategies scientifically by combining its quantitative expertise with sophisticated understanding of derivatives and financial markets. The team is looking to add Quantitative Developers who will work alongside researchers, traders, and system engineers to develop software that incorporates vast amounts of data to drive sophisticated strategies, capturing market opportunities before our competition. The successful candidate will have a strong programming background to produce trading solutions and high-performance production code. In this role you will: 
 
 Design and develop production code of trading strategies: pricing models, execution logic and performance optimization 
 Develop and improve data and research pipeline 
 Advance existing codebase and propose new solutions and improvements 
 
  Requirements for this role:  
 
 3+ years of experience developing performant, scalable applications in modern C++ 
 BS/MS/PhD degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, or equivalent 
 Experience using data to drive decision-making 
 Desire and ability to learn the intricacies of financial markets 
  Willing to prepare and take English technical interviews  
 
  Qualities that make great candidates:  
 
 Solid understanding of multi-threaded/multi-core programming paradigms 
 Experience with high frequency trading system 
 Deeper understanding of any of the following fields: Linear Algebra, Numerical Methods, Statistics, Optimization, Signal Processing, Computer Architecture, Machine Learning, Heterogeneous/High Performance computing 
 The ability to react quickly and accurately to rapidly changing market conditions, including the ability to quickly and accurately respond and/or solve math and coding problems are essential functions of the role 
 Passion towards financial markets and trading

title: Staff Machine Learning Scientist
description:

Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs. 
 At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security. 
 Visit  Careers at Netskope  to learn more. Follow us on  LinkedIn  and  Instagram .    About the role  
   Please note, this team is hiring across all levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience.   
 Within Netskope Engineering, the  Netskope AI Labs  is responsible for advancing state-of-the-art artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technology to power the Netskope Intelligent Security Service Edge (SSE) security platform. Leveraging our expertise in AI/ML and security, we are developing large-scale AI/ML solutions for SSE. For example, we are integrating the latest AI/ML technology into our data security and threat protection features, as well as business operations. 
  What’s in it for you  
 We are looking for a talented and motivated machine learning scientist to join our team. A successful candidate has deep technical expertise in applying AI/ML technologies in security applications and/or adjacent domains, and must be passionate about cloud security and AI security. You will have the opportunity to work with a team of talented engineers, researchers, and machine learning engineers to solve the most challenging cloud security problems today.    
  What you will be doing  
 
 Identify strong AI/ML use cases in AI security, data security, and adjacent domains, leveraging Netskope’s rich set of data sources 
 Define scalable data acquisition and labeling strategy for specific use cases 
 Work with data engineers to retrieve, clean, and normalize data and ensure a scalable and continuous high-quality data stream 
 Work closely with threat research and development teams in feature engineering, making sure high-quality feature sets are chosen in a systematic way 
 Develop ML models for defined use cases and implement KPIs to ensure optimal algorithms and results 
 Conduct strict internal testing to ensure high efficacy, low false positive and false negative rate 
 Interpret results and communicate findings 
 Document use case, data acquisition, feature engineering, training, validation, deployment, future improvement opportunity, and other important aspects 
 Work closely with development and QE teams in productization 
 Be an evangelist of AI/ML within Netskope and promote AI/ML wherever applicable, beyond security use cases 
 Staying up-to-date with the latest developments in AI/ML such as large language models (LLM) 
 
  Required skills and experience  
 
 Must have a true startup spirit and be willing to wear multiple hats and deliver end-to-end solutions 
 8+ years of industry experience in developing AI/ML models, preferably on security products or services 
 Hands-on experience with relevant technology stacks such as CUDA, Python, Tensorflow, LLM, etc.

title: VP, Greater China Region (GCR)
description:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.    Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.   The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.    We are looking for a strong business leader to lead our fast-growing business in the Greater China region, who will be responsible for driving our business strategy and growth, without compromising on innovation or our Company culture. The person will also have the proven ability to inspire and empower their teams to stretch themselves to achieve ever greater goals and to collaborate closely both locally and globally. You will also mentor and lead our business teams to build consultative business relationships and ensure long-term client success.     
  The person is a strategic business leader – with a strong ability to envision, create and execute on highest impact growth opportunities, to shape and influence how the markets think about our industry and company and can foster the most senior, strategic relationships in the respective regions. This person will be motivated by a desire to make advertising work better for brands, publishers, and partners in those markets.     
  They must have a high aptitude for and comfort level with working in complex business and technology environments along with a strong leadership and business acumen.     
  This role can be based in Hong Kong     
   What You'll Do      
 
  Will be the external and internal figurehead for the TTD’s China, Taiwan and Hong Kong business     
  Lead team to develop and land strategic market plans to achieve revenue goals     
  Working with the team to define and lead an effective upstream sales strategy     
  Own and sponsor relationships with senior levels of stakeholders within target accounts and partners     
  Collaborate with other functional leaders to identify growth opportunities, solve business challenges and drive efficiency across the organization     
  Strong cultural leadership across the whole GCR business.  Driver in creating an environment that inspires the Sales organization to perform effectively and efficiently     
  Ensure effective team management through coaching, mentoring and development of the team     
  Contribute in product roadmap build-out discussions based on client needs with senior leadership, product, & engineering     
 
   Who You Are      
 
  15+ years of experience in online advertising. At least 10 years in a team leadership capacity     
  Deep understanding of the advertising landscape and agency ecosystem across GCR, including China export      
  Proven track record of working within GCR region and strong relationships in the regional markets     
  Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to speak to C-Level clients and establish client relationships     
  Proven track record of driving and exceeding revenue expectations through a history of sales leadership experience     
  Strong management and leadership skills through a collaborative team approach     
  Proactive in managing and developing talent as well as talent attraction

title: Senior Human Resources Business Partner
description:

  The HR team helps protect the firm's largest investment: our people. As a Senior HRBP in our global People Operations team, you'll work with business leaders on complex organizational challenges as the business changes and help keep our culture strong along the way. A large part of the role is coaching. You'll be a trusted coach to leaders and managers, helping them lead their teams, handle hard moments and grow their people. The role is both strategic and hands-on. You'll care about the people, and you'll also see how a great workplace drives business results.     
  We work in a flat, consensus-driven environment where influence matters more than hierarchy. Our team is innovative, driven, collaborative and trustworthy, and we care about what we do and who we do it with.     
    What   you'll   do       
 
   Partner on people strategy.    Be a thought partner to business leaders. Turn business strategy into decisions on workforce planning, org design, succession and talent. Help managers set their annual priorities and plans.   
   Coach leaders and managers.    Be a trusted one-to-one coach to senior leaders and people managers. Provide coaching on leadership style, performance and feedback conversations, team dynamics, stakeholder relationships and leading through change. Help leaders see their blind spots and build habits to address them.   
   Develop talent.    Help managers grow their people through development plans, internal moves and global career opportunities. Identify high-potential talent and support succession planning.   
   Build coaching capability across the firm.    Support first-time and newly promoted managers through the transition into leadership. Run coaching-based conversations and small-group sessions that grow management capability. Help build a culture where feedback and development happen continuously, not just at review time.  
   Lead employee relations.    Spot, reduce and resolve employee issues and conflict early, with sound judgment, discretion and fairness. Manage ER cases end to end, including grievances, investigations, performance and disciplinary matters, and sensitive exits, working closely with Legal.  The successful candidate is someone who is passionate about both hardware and software technology with interest to grow into business development.  We are hiring for positions across early career to senior roles, with scope ranging from small exploratory partnerships to managing our largest and most strategic partnerships.

Our Shanghai office works with the latest hardware and software technologies to develop high performance low latency solutions that are robust and scalable, ensuring our strategies are as fast as possible for Akuna’s global trading operations.  Develop trading strategies using statistical and deep learning technologies

 Architecting and implementing critical software infrastructure for distributed large-scale multi-cloud environments

 Being a catalyst for improving engineering processes and ownership 
 Researching, incubating, and driving new technologies to ensure we are leveraging the latest innovations 
 Please note, this team is hiring across Software Engineer, Sr. Software Engineer and Staff Software Engineer levels and all candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience.

 8+ years of experience including 2+ years of experience building cloud environments  
 Excellent Unix/Linux experience and programming experience with Go, C/C++, Java and scripting: Python, Ruby, Shell 
 Understanding of IPC mechanisms and previous experience working with: TCP/IP, Kafka, ZMQ, gRPC, ZooKeeper.

 BSCS or equivalent required, MSCS or equivalent strongly preferred

title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer - Linux, PC, IoT
description:
Canonical is a growing international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu, “the world’s best free software platform”. The Commercial Engineering Quality Assurance (QA) team works with all the engineering teams in Canonical, OEM and ODM customers, to bring Ubuntu directly to millions of users by delivering certified Ubuntu laptop, desktop, IoT and other computing devices. 
 As a Software QA engineer, you will join the team responsible for our strategy for quality coordination and testing. You will be a quality expert with extensive experience establishing quality processes from the ground up. You will understand the tools and techniques used to introduce new products, and will work with teams across the company to drive quality improvements through the entire development cycle. 
 Location: This is an office-based role in Beijing. 
  As a Software Quality Assurance Engineer you will:  
 
 Plan, create and manage the overall Quality Planning strategy and document 
 Improve our automated test capability with design and code contributions 
 Perform automated and manual testing of Ubuntu Desktop, Server and Core on varies latest hardware. 
 Suggest solutions to identified product problems

 Communicate effectively with colleagues in a variety of time zones around the world

  The successful Software Quality Assurance Engineer will have :  
 
 Experience with the Linux desktop, and related technologies. Ubuntu experience would be a plus 
 Solid grasp of commercial Software QA practices and ideas on how to integrate them into Linux Community standards 
 Experience with common scripting languages, including Shell script, Python or JavaScript 
 Comfortable with online communication and collaboration such as mailing lists, Mattermost, wiki 
 Excellent logic, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills 
 Strong written and spoken communication skills in English 
 Ability to be productive in a globally distributed team 
 Ability to pick up new technologies and achieve high effectiveness quickly

 Learning and development

 Recognition rewards

  About Canonical  
 Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. title: Trading Intern
description:
Flow Traders is looking for entrepreneurial, competitive, and analytical students to join our Trading department as an Intern. What better way to find out if a career in Trading is something for you, than by experiencing it yourself as a Trading Intern! 
 You will get a 360-degree view of our role in the financial markets, how our Traders seize opportunities, and how they work together as a team to optimize and improve their trading desk. This Trading internship is about immersing yourself in the financial markets and experiencing trading up close. You do not need to have a financial background; we will teach you all you need to know. 
 Experience with a scientific programming language or excel is a definite advantage. Working closely with Traders and Quantitative Researchers, you will add value by working on real trading projects. You will solve problems, create new tools and/or design new strategies. You will test your project in a trading simulation. 
 What You Will Do 
 
 Learn directly from industry leaders on the APAC Trading floor 
 Participate in educational courses and trading simulations 
 Design trading strategies through project-based work using quantitative modelling and trading applications 
 Work through real life trading problems with our Traders and Quantitative Researchers 
 Gain insight into Flow Traders’ core business 
 Participate in intern activities and become a part of our “One Team” culture 
 
  Internship Duration    
 
 June 2027 - July 2027/ December 2027 - January 2028 
 This is a full-time paid internship and will last for 6 weeks 
 Flight and accommodation will be provided to all successful overseas applicants. 
 
 What You Need to Succeed 
 
 Graduating between August 2027 and December 2028 with a Degree in Finance, Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or related disciplines 
 Experience with a scientific programming language (e.g. Python / MATLAB / R or similar) 
 Competitive, innovative & creative personality with excellent mental arithmetic skills 
 Capability to reason logically and deliver under pressure 
 Ability to spot opportunities and the assertiveness to seize them   
 
  If you do not receive a confirmation email after you applied on our website, please contact  careers.hongkong@hk.flowtraders.com .

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Assistance Engineering
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.     Your Location:  
  This position is CHINA BASED . The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. Your recruiter will inform you what cities you are able to work from depending on your personal legal working identity and Airbnb internal policies. 
   
  The Community You Will Join:  
 Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence are at the heart of the Airbnb product. From Trust to Payments, and from Customer Service to Marketing we rely on ML to ensure that guests and hosts have the best possible experience with Airbnb.  
 The Community Support Products (CSP) Machine Learning team is the core team responsible for driving CSxAI (Customer Support x Artificial Intelligence) initiatives by adopting the Generative AI technologies to enable an intelligent, scalable and exceptional service experience. The team develops and enhances various AI models, ML services and tools including LLM fine-tuning and optimization, RAG/Search,  LLM evaluation and testing automation, feedback-based learning and guardrail for a wide range of applications in Airbnb.  
 The richness of Airbnb's data, the complexity of its marketplace and the variety innate in our product mean that we need to operate at the state of the art of AI practice. We are committed to investing in long term innovation to solve the complex problems we face, and to do that we need the very best experts in ML and AI to join us. 
   
  The Difference You Will Make:  
 We believe our current customer experiences in these domains are only scratching the surface of the innovations that are possible, and that science is at the heart of delivering a step-function change for our Guest and and Host on Airbnb.  
 You will build and leverage cutting edge AI technologies to transform Airbnb’s customer service by delivering personalized, easy-to-use and proactive customer service experience.  
 Many of the initiatives you’ll tackle are in their early conceptual stages. You will have the opportunity to shape these ideas from inception to production, turning visionary concepts into impactful realities. 
   
  A Typical Day:   
 
 
 Envision, champion, and support the development of novel ML systems, product integrations, and performance optimizations to solve real-world problems 
 
 
 Work cross-functionally with product, design, and other engineering counterparts to design and build efficient AI solutions for Airbnb CS products 
 
 
 Learn and share the latest AI/ML technologies with the team across regions( China and the US).  
 
 
   
  Your Expertise:  
 
 PhD/Master’s degree, preferably in CS, or equivalent experience 
 2-4 years of ML engineering experience, with ownership responsibility over large-scale software systems.  
 Background in the design and development of AI and ML systems and services, and a deep passion for building efficient and scalable ML-powered products 
 Experience with LLM driven chatbot and Agentic AI products would be a big plus 
 Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a team and with teams across the engineering, product & design organizations 
  Fluency in both English and Mandarin is essential.  
 
   
  Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:  
 Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.     
   Reasonable Accommodations:  We are committed to providing reasonable acco

title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator
description:
Jump Trading Group is committed to world class research. We empower exceptional talents in Mathematics, Physics, and Computer Science to seek scientific boundaries, push through them, and apply cutting edge research to global financial markets. Our culture is unique. Constant innovation requires fearlessness, creativity, intellectual honesty, and a relentless competitive streak. We believe in winning together and unlocking unique individual talent through collaboration and mutual respect. At Jump, research outcomes drive more than superior risk adjusted returns. We design, develop, and deploy technologies that change our world, fund start-ups across industries, and partner with leading global research organizations and universities to solve problems. 
 We are seeking a self-driven and motivated individual to join Jump’s Recruiting Team! If you have a natural curiosity to learn about talent acquisition and on-boarding new hires in the fin-tech space, we encourage you to explore this opportunity with Jump. Attracting and retaining premier talent is our top priority and the Talent Acquisition Coordinator will collaborate extensively with the HR and Recruiting teams to provide a world class recruiting experience with Jump. 
 What You'll Do:

 Collaborate extensively with global recruiting team to create successful strategies for marketing Jump and building our brand. 
 Other duties as assigned or needed. 
 
  
 Skills You'll Need: 
  
 
 Strong organizational skills. 
 Must be proficient in MS Outlook, Word & Excel. 
 At least 3+ years previous administrative experience strongly preferred. 
 Previous experience using an ATS, CRM, or candidate management tool preferred but not required. 
 Excellent data entry skills and exceptional attention to detail. 
 A hardworking and upbeat personality. 
 Proactive and resourceful problem-solving skills. 
 Experience working in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment. 
 Excellent communicator with a customer service mindset. 
 Reliable and predictable availability.

We are seeking skilled engineers to build scalable distributed systems and integrate agentic AI and conversational analytics. As a Senior Staff Engineer, you will lead the architecture, data modeling, and core infrastructure powering our next-generation AI and analytics platforms.

 Qualifications

 Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly. 
 Bachelor or Master degree in STEM majors. 
 Strong algorithms, data structures, and coding background with either Java, Python, or Scala programming experience (Python highly preferred for AI/ML ecosystem compatibility).

 Experience building products using at least 1 of each of the following distributed technologies:  - Relational Stores  (i.e. Postgres, MySQL, or Oracle)  - Columnar, NoSQL, or Vector Stores  (i.e. Starrocks, Clickhouse, BigQuery, Pinecone or pgvector)  - Distributed Processing Engines  (i.e. Apache Spark, Apache Flink)  - Distributed Queues  (i.e. Apache Kafka, AWS Kinesis, or GCP PubSub)

  Operating What You Build.  Join the shared on-call rotation and monitor the health of your services.

title: Experienced MFT Quantitative Researcher
description:
Flow Traders is looking for an Experienced Quantitative Researcher who specializes in mid-frequency research to join us in our Hong Kong office. This is a unique opportunity to join a leading proprietary trading firm where quantitative research, technology, and an entrepreneurial culture are at the heart of our business. 
 In this role, you will identify and develop new trading opportunities by leveraging Flow Traders’ advanced research capabilities and quantitative trading platform.

title: PhD Graduate Quantitative Researcher
description:
Flow Traders is looking for a PhD Graduate Quantitative Researcher to join the quantitative trading team at our Hong Kong office. This is a unique opportunity to join a leading proprietary trading firm, working alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry. As a firm, we are committed to leveraging advances in computer science, statistics, and machine learning to generate value in the financial markets. 
 A successful Quantitative Researcher is an expert in mathematics and statistics, passionate about translating challenging quantitative problems into equations and models, and skilled at optimizing them using cutting-edge computational techniques. If you're at the top of your quantitative, modeling, and coding game, and excited to test these skills in competitive live markets, this opportunity is for you. 
   
  What you will do  
 
 Design, build, optimize, and deploy state-of-the-art models and algorithms for systematic trading. 
 Analyze large datasets to identify patterns and signals that can be translated into trading strategies.

description:
This role is one of our general tracks. Apply here for all engineering teams at Canonical who work on low-level system technology on autonomous devices across all seniority levels. 
 We hire careful and conscientious engineers who appreciate the challenge of memory, performance, battery and connectivity constrained code that has to work every time in an unreliable and unforgiving world, on x86, ARM or RISC-V silicon. 
 Canonical Ubuntu is the leading Linux for software engineers, desktops, cloud and IoT. We bring open source to the world as a high-performance, safe and secure platform for enterprise computing, software engineering, and connected devices. 
 These smart, connected devices have the potential to transform every industry. Classic Ubuntu – desktop or server – is widely used in embedded systems because of its developer focus and enterprise grade security maintenance. We partner with the world's most prominent silicon companies to optimise Ubuntu on their latest and greatest chips, as well as with major OEMs and ODMs (PC, servers and connected device manufacturers) to ensure that Ubuntu works perfectly on their hardware.

From outstanding routing implementations like Bird and FRR to overlay networking technology such as OVN/OVS and Cilium, from kernel with SwitchDev to userspace with DPDK, from P4 to OpenFlow, the relationship between network innovation and software continues to deepen. We are building teams to bring the very best open source networking software to market in a well integrated and opinionated stack that brings the latest hyperscaler innovation to end users and enterprise customers. 
 We work with networking silicon providers to optimize Ubuntu and related applications for their ASICs, boards and appliances. We aim to provide a complete open source stack for data center networking, from bare metal through virtualization, container and serverless, and also to address IoT networking systematically. 
 You will have a good chance of success if you are an outstanding software engineer, passionate about networking, with a special interest in the interface of hardware ASICs for acceleration and software for innovation and control. We value experience in open switch initiatives such as SoNIC and DENT, and upstream experience with components such as routing, kernel networking, eBPF, DNS, firewalls and load balancers. Our selection process is rigorous and requires work from the candidate as six to eight interviews over a period of months. description:

 The Canonical Kernel Team is looking for a Test Engineer to take ownership of our kernel testing strategy and infrastructure. title: Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Hardware Certification Quality and Test Engineering
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform,  Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives  such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. 
 The company is founder led, profitable and growing. 
 We are hiring an  Engineering Manager for Ubuntu Hardware Certification Quality Engineering , to lead the team responsible for the test suites which validate hardware compatibility with Ubuntu Linux (Core, Desktop and Server – see  https://ubuntu.com/certified  for more information). We work together with silicon companies, OEMs, ODMs and teams within Canonical to ensure a smooth, secure out of the box Ubuntu experience, with success in this role leading to a great Ubuntu experience being offered on more and more devices. 
 As the Engineering Manager of the Certification Quality team you’ll lead a dedicated testing team, shaping the vision and setting the pace, in collaboration with the rest of the Certification and hardware enablement teams. You will lead the certification test strategy for Canonical’s PC OEM and ODM partnerships, including Advantech, ASUS, Dell, HP,  and Lenovo, deepening the test coverage for both new and existing certified hardware. You will pioneer the use of Canonical’s open source test frameworks and custom designed hardware to drive automated hardware validation of the operating system. This is a challenging position for a quality focused engineering leader, and requires an analytical mind with a passion for test automation and team leadership.

 This role entails
